_meta.notes: Envelope Lazada Push Mechanism (LPM). `message_type` 0 = forward/order, reverse = return/refund/cancel. `data` objek (bukan string). Signature: header `Authorization` = hex lowercase HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, rawBody). ACK: HTTP 200 (secepat mungkin, docs menyebut < 500ms); retry tiap 30 menit s/d 12x. order_status lowercase: unpaid, pending, ready_to_ship, shipped, delivered, canceled, returned, failed.
